purpose: One current-candidate 900s background long-residence under isolated native 4096 load; no foreground equivalence claim
activities: Preregister target inactive and same frontmost PID as t0; sample each point; stop on loss, no automatic retries
during_timing: No input/screenshots/profiler/compiler/tests; normal blink and workload unchanged
analysis: CPU one-core and RSS first/last-minute medians, extrema and slope. RSS is not footprint/leak proof; descriptive n1 no matched prior long pair
data: Config bytes and all request/cost business fields equality before/after UI and Core stop; real HTTP only, no SQL inserts
cleanup: Stop/wait owned processes then full and immediate exact-root preflight; retain evidence and shared baselines
